summary: Iteration 4 — Royal Shades v2.1 fully verified. Backend: 24/24 PASS in test_rsc_v2_1.py covering (a) username-based login + email fallback + duplicate-username 400, (b) register with username creates working user, (c) 1316 catalogs in DB / 100 suppliers, (d) search by name (INFINITY) and by cat_no (BX-440A->HANGER), (e) catalog items expose cat_no/quantity/supplier_id, (f) staff hidden buying_price / admin sees it, (g) PATCH RBAC (staff 403, supervisor 403, admin 200), (h) CRITICAL FIX verified: issue->return->catalog status=Available->re-issue same catalog succeeds with new TXN, (i) every POST /api/issues AND /api/returns returns transaction_id matching ^TXN-\d{4,}$ with monotonic counter, (j) GET /api/issues items include transaction_id, supplier_name, cat_no, catalog_code, catalog_name, (k) dashboard totals include due_today/due_week/overdue/issued/returned (returned>=1 after a return), (l) reports/issues CSV has all 13 required columns, XLSX returns PK zip, PDF returns %PDF, (m) /api/reports/employee-wise returns rows with employee_name/total_issues/active/returned, (n) scans for RSC-00001 return catalog, ZZZZ-NOPE 404, (o) returns RBAC staff 403 / supervisor 200. Frontend smoke (admin): Login page shows 'Royal Shades Curtains LLC' (NO 'And') and 2 inputs (Username + Password). After login top bar shows 'Royal Shades Curtains LLC · Dubai'. Dashboard 4 widgets present; clicking 'Due Today' navigates to /issues-returns?filter=due_today. Catalogs page shows all 9 columns (Code, Cat No, Name, Supplier, Qty, Selling, Buying, Status, Actions); searching 'BX-440A' surfaces HANGER catalog; archive button absent; 'Reset filters' present. Issues/Returns has Txn ID + Supplier columns and TXN-* values. Reports page shows Issue Report card and Catalog Report card each with PDF/Excel/CSV buttons (3 each, 2 cards) plus Employee-wise section. Users page lists username column; Add User dialog has Username field + optional Email + Display Name + Password + Role.

minor.issue: Cookies still set with secure=False (carry-over from prior iterations). Low-priority hardening — recommended once site is HTTPS-only in prod.

supplier_id is returned but supplier_name is NOT included in catalog list items (it's only joined in GET /api/issues items). Frontend currently renders supplier by matching against /api/suppliers; cheap N=1316 lookup table is fine but a precomputed supplier_name on the list response would be cleaner.

issues: Bottom-left still shows 'admin@fabriccatalog.com' (email). Since v2.1 made login username-based, this should display the username ('admin') first with email secondary, otherwise users will be confused about what identifier to type at login.

Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — accessibility lint from Radix Dialog. Add a DialogDescription or aria-describedby to silence and improve a11y.

action_items: (Low) Update sidebar 'SIGNED IN AS' block to show username as primary identifier (email secondary).
(Low) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Create User dialog (and any other DialogContent that triggers the Radix a11y warning).
(Optional) Include supplier_name on each item in GET /api/catalogs response (currently only supplier_id) to avoid client-side join with /api/suppliers.
(Carry-over, low) Harden auth cookies with secure=True over HTTPS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1372 lines (+182 since iter 3). Splitting into modules (auth.py, catalogs.py, issues.py, returns.py, reports.py, dashboard.py, scans.py, employees.py, users.py) is increasingly overdue — testability and maintainability will degrade fast on the next feature.

Transaction counter (next_transaction_id) — verify atomicity. If implemented via find+update or a counters collection without findOneAndUpdate {upsert:true,returnDocument:'after'} + $inc, concurrent issue/return requests could mint duplicate TXN ids. Recommend a single findOneAndUpdate on a counters doc, and a unique index on transaction_id in catalog_issues and catalog_returns as a safety net.

Returns endpoint now flips catalog.status to 'Available' (correct behaviour). Make sure to also re-set is_available=true and clear any current_issue_id/customer_name fields stored on the catalog, otherwise reports filtering on Is Available may diverge from status.
GET /api/reports/issues/{csv,xlsx,pdf} have no role gating in the test — verify ACL: should staff be allowed to download Mobile + Customer Name PII? Recommend admin/supervisor only.
Employee-wise report aggregation: ensure employees with 0 issues are excluded (or explicitly included with zeros) consistently — current shape unclear from API doc.
Catalog import auto-creates suppliers/categories silently — already raised in iter 3, still recommended to log into audit and expose in import summary.
Frontend Login.jsx — confirm `autocomplete='username'` on the username field (browsers will otherwise keep autofilling email).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login/branding, dashboard widgets+filter nav, catalogs columns+search+no-archive, issues TXN+supplier, reports cards, users dialog username field)

test_credentials: Admin: admin / Admin@123 (also accepts admin@royalshades.ae or admin@fabriccatalog.com as 'username'). Supervisor/staff created with timestamped usernames per pytest session.
seed_data_creation: Per-session unique usernames testuser_<ts>, staff_<ts>, sup_<ts>. Created 1-2 RSC-/TST- catalogs via Issue->Return->Re-issue flow. No cleanup required — usernames are unique per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v2.1 backend at 100% (24/24 in test_rsc_v2_1.py). Two suites still useful: test_rsc_v2.py (v2 RBAC + bulk import) and test_rsc_v2_1.py (v2.1 username + CAT NO + TXN + reports). 1316 catalogs imported; RSC-00001 (INFINITY SHEERS I) and RSC-00039 (cat_no BX-440A, name HANGER) are good fixed reference rows. Login by username works AND email fallback works. Dashboard widget click pattern: /issues-returns?filter=<due_today|due_week|overdue|active>. Only minor cosmetic/a11y issues remain.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all targeted v2.1 changes verified clean. The CRITICAL bug fix (returned catalogs were stuck at status='Returned' and could not be re-issued) is correctly resolved: after POST /api/returns the catalog status is set to 'Available' and the same catalog can immediately be POSTed to /api/issues with a fresh TXN id.
